ideas.title: Living Brass Urli Entrance with Float Candles & Marigold Carpeting
ideas.description: Flank the 60-foot entrance walkway with traditional hammered brass urlis overflowing with fragrant fresh yellow mogra and floating beeswax diya candles.

ideas.title: Live Clay-Oven Kathiyawadi & Fusion Mocktail Bar
ideas.description: A rustic village-style station baking Bajra Rotla with white fresh Makhan and organic Gud, paired with smoked Jamun Shots and refreshing Aam Panna coolers.

ideas.title: Bespoke Bandhani Pagdi & Dupatta Bar for Welcoming Baraat
ideas.description: A live turban tying artisan at the entrance styling groomsmen in custom maroon Bandhani safas and gifting ladies tissue silk dupattas.

risks.title: December Evening Lawn Dew & Sudden Chill
risks.why: December night temperature in Ahmedabad drops to 13°C after 9 PM, causing heavy grass dew that dampens traditional silk sarees and makes elderly guests uncomfortable.
risks.mitigation: Install heavy tarpaulin sub-flooring with red carpet over the lawn seating area and arrange 6 brass patio radiant gas heaters.
risks.backup_plan: Keep 40 warm pashmina shawls in wicker baskets by the mandap entrance and maintain hot Badam Milk counter.

risks.title: Municipal 10:00 PM Loudspeaker Curfew Enforcement
risks.why: Ahmedabad police actively monitor SG Highway event lawns; loud amplifiers running past 10 PM face immediate power shutdown and fines.
risks.mitigation: Front-load high-energy baraat and Jaimala to 5:30 PM - 7:30 PM so amplification winds down on schedule.
risks.backup_plan: Transition sacred mandap chanting after 10 PM to acoustic flutist and low-decibel boundary monitors.

risks.title: 35% Jain Dietary Segregation & Pre-Sunset Chouviar Timing
risks.why: Jain elders must dine strictly before sunset (~5:55 PM in December) with strict exclusion of root vegetables (potatoes, onions, garlic).
risks.mitigation: Open the specialized Jain buffet wing at 5:15 PM sharp with clear signage and dedicated head chef supervision.
risks.backup_plan: Prepare 45 pre-packaged gourmet Jain meal hampers ready by 4:45 PM for early arriving elders.
